methodology: Each stock receives one equal capital slot; all slots start in cash.
A retained strong LONG buys at its first same-day formal 5-minute V2 trigger.
A retained strong SHORT sells at its first same-day formal 5-minute V2 trigger.
The 15:00 observation is reconciled to official daily OHLCV before final signal evaluation.
Open positions are marked to the last qfq close at each month end.
Monthly return is portfolio month-end NAV divided by prior month-end NAV.
Per-stock realized monthly return compounds trades closed in that month.
warnings: Five-minute replay is the finest official free BaoStock history available; it cannot identify a trigger inside a five-minute bar.
Results use qfq prices and estimated costs, not broker fills or complete tax lots.
Weak signals are explanatory only and are not traded.

definition.baseline: strong markers at first formal 5-minute trigger
definition.comparison: all displayed strong and weak raw crosses; weak markers execute at first same-direction raw 5-minute formula cross

intraday_replay.price_contract: first 5-minute close where the final daily strong marker meets its formal V2 threshold

paper_validation.limitation: Historical book assumed at minute close with 100000 shares; accounting acceptance only, not measured live returns.

source.stability: monthly pages internally consistent; transient count and malformed-response drift was observed during probes

contract.outcome: realized return >=10% OR max floating profit >=20%
contract.model: predefined balanced logistic C=0.03; fit Jan-Apr, inspect May-Jun, refit Jan-Jun, untouched Jul-Sep
contract.acceptance: AP > 0, AUC >= 0, and Top-5% precision delta >= 0 in May-Jun, Jul-Aug, and Sep

winner_announcements.conclusion: 公告特征未在三个时间区间形成稳定增量，不应接入交易决策。
limitations: Historical CNInfo announcementTime is generally date-level 00:00 rather than an exact publication time.
Keyword retrieval can include contextual mentions; features are counts, not semantic claims.
Categories with changing record counts or malformed pages are excluded instead of retried.
CNInfo full-text search showed transient count drift during probes, so the cached single pass is not treated as a production-grade feed.
No paid data, auction history, or Level-2 order flow is used.

contract.entry: next 5-minute close only if LONG remains; unfilled slot stays cash

acceptance.requires: Immediate staged Top5 return-winner and MFE-winner precision both exceed V2 in every split

limitations: The profile and staged policy were developed after inspecting the fixed 2026 sample; prospective shadow validation remains mandatory.

contracts.signal_close_price: Signal bar close; optimistic because exact fill at the just-observed close is not guaranteed.
contracts.next_bar_open_price: First trade price of the next 5-minute interval; closest historical proxy for the next independent quote.
contracts.entry_price: Next 5-minute bar close; conservative delayed execution.
contracts.exit: Identical original SHORT/horizon exit for all arms.

acceptance.requires_opportunity: Selected mean MFE, opportunity/risk multiple, profit-10-before-loss-5 rate and MFE>=20% rate all exceed the same-split full candidate baseline.
acceptance.requires_buy_control: Opportunity acceptance plus at least five <=5% entry candidates and positive mean realized return in every future split.

limitations: The highest opportunity scores are usually observed after a large same-day move; opportunity detection does not grant buy eligibility.
The September split has a shorter observable path, so relative same-split improvement is used instead of an absolute MFE threshold.
Five-minute historical bars cannot reproduce exact one-minute live execution or queue position.

entry_contract.guard: signal return <=5% and point-in-time stability passed
entry_contract.fill: next 5-minute close only if LONG remains
entry_contract.exit: first raw SHORT with T+1, otherwise 20-trading-day horizon

model.objective: 65% probability of positive realized net return + 35% probability maximum floating loss stays above -5%

acceptance.requires: Risk and fill-rate improvement plus <=5% loss event rate and positive slot net return in validation, heldout and final short holdout.

signal_quality.conclusion: 首次涨幅不超过5%且当时稳定性通过，可稳定降低浮亏和下一周期信号消失风险；收益模型在9月短留出仍为负，因此只能作为风险门，不能作为正式买入推荐。
limitations: Historical five-minute observations cannot reproduce exact one-minute live state changes or order-book fills.
The final September split has a shorter complete future path and represents a different market regime.
Point-in-time perturbation stability is available; multi-minute persistence is enforced by next-bar fill rather than used as a future feature.

method.score: equal weight point-in-time cohort ranks of efficiency 10/20, trend R2 10/20 and distance to 20/60-day highs
method.guard: signal return <=3% and point-in-time stability passed

september_5d.contract: next five-minute close if LONG remains; first raw SHORT with T+1, otherwise fifth trading-day close

acceptance.requires: Positive fixed-budget return, loss-5 rate <=20%, and at least 90% resolved selections plus a date-bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero in validation, July, August and untouched September five-day stress.

quality_selection.conclusion: 稳定、低追高且趋势一致的因果筛选，在验证期、7月、8月和9月固定5日点估计均为正，但各期95%区间仍跨零，9月收益还受少数大涨样本影响；仅可作为影子排名，不能作为正式买入。
limitations: The fixed 2026 sample is insufficient for statistically confident trade control; prospective shadow data is required.
September twenty-day outcomes are right-censored, so acceptance uses an untouched fixed five-trading-day outcome.
Five late-September executed selections remain censored even at the five-day horizon; their slots stay cash in reported point estimates and resolution is shown separately.
Historical five-minute closes cannot reproduce exact one-minute execution, order book or queue position.

contract.signal: first formal five-minute LONG across full session
contract.selection: point-in-time stability and signal return <=3%, then equal-weight trend efficiency, trend R2 and distance-to-high cohort ranks >=0.65
contract.signal_strength: strong when point-in-time retention probability is at least 0.525; otherwise weak

contract.universe: eligible Shanghai and Shenzhen main-board stocks
contract.baseline_entry: every first raw LONG no later than 10:00
contract.candidate_entry: only trend-consistency quality candidates whose first signal return is no more than 3% and stability passed
contract.opportunity_observation_entry: all selected quality observations; backward-compatible diagnostic label
contract.fill: next 5-minute close only if LONG remains
contract.exit: next 5-minute close after raw SHORT, T+1 enforced
contract.capital: one independent equal-capital account per stock

formal_all_signal_reference.reason: all-day strong+weak formal triggers use a different signal universe and entry contract

winner_shadow.warning: Entry states are prospective shadow evidence only. Historical single-threshold pullback and sector rules were unstable, and this state machine cannot place trades.

contracts.recommended_history_entry: next 5-minute interval open as the first independent trade proxy
contracts.live_entry: next independent best ask/bid quote with depth, costs and slippage
